hypothesis: A policy trained only for the post-root continuation role, on the deployed pruned action support and completed-round margin, will reduce the continuation bias seen in reviewed rollout decisions while preserving the proven root policy, value, belief, and shortlist.
claim_boundary: A continuation checkpoint is not a new general champion. It can be promoted only as the second checkpoint of a dual-network rollout actor after the locked full-match gate.

source.platform: Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9V74, 9 visible CPUs
source.thread_rule: All training families run serially on this build and use four threads. A thread-count change creates a different campaign and is ineligible.

root_and_anchor.role: Immutable root policy, value, belief, shortlist, and PPO anchor

required_passes: GCC AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer on the runtime and continuation-PPO support tests
preflight.legacy_compatibility: The one-network actor and the explicit dual actor with identical root/continuation checkpoints must remain byte-identical in move, value, diagnostics, and RNG behavior.
preflight.root_safety: Before and after every command, verify the root SHA-256. Any direct-path, relative-path, symlink, hard-link, or generated .itN alias failure invalidates the campaign.

training.optimizer_boundary: Adam state is intentionally reset between the v6-only warm-up and full phase because optimizer state is not serialized.
iteration_validity: baseline roots plus challenger roots equal 4098
first learned actor row is round ply 15
exact deck-one moves equal 4098 and receive no actor row
losses and gradients are finite and at least one optimizer update occurs
the immutable root fingerprint and SHA-256 remain unchanged
reservoir retention and cycle/cap-reserve force counts are recorded

operational_self_control.required: Exactly zero margin, 0.5 score, zero SE, and zero caps

screen_a.scope: All 18 predeclared eligible checkpoints; model selection only
screen_a.eligibility: Discard operationally invalid candidates and any candidate whose margin or round-score point estimate is below parity.
screen_a.ranking: Within each family maximize min(margin/margin_SE, (round_score-0.5)/score_SE); break ties by margin lower bound, then the earlier locked checkpoint. Select exactly one checkpoint per family.

screen_b.scope: The three Screen-A family winners; model selection only
aggregate_gate: zero cap-terminated tails and exact provenance
screen_b.round_safety: For each round separately, both score + 1.645*SE >= 0.5 and margin + 1.645*SE >= 0; this rules out a conclusively harmful round.
screen_b.seed_robustness: At least two of three independent training families must pass both aggregate bounds. Any failing third family must satisfy the same non-harm upper-bound rule against parity.
screen_b.winner: Among passing family winners maximize the same minimum-z statistic. No other checkpoint may be substituted.

screen_c.scope: One selected checkpoint in the complete dual-network actor; still not promotion evidence
screen_c.dependency: Wait for the authoritative role-coherent result and mechanically select the same actor family for candidate and baseline.
gate: combined candidate match-score point estimate is at least 0.5
combined candidate point margin is positive
zero caps, malformed rows, provenance drift, or operational defects
screen_c.stop_rule: If this screen fails, stop. Do not test the runner-up on the same deals.

actor_family_dependency.invalid_role_result_rule: If the role test is invalid or incomplete, do not run Screen C or the final gate.
actor_family_dependency.world_800_exclusion: Keep both actors at 512 worlds. The separate conditional 800-world experiment is neither pooled nor combined with this campaign. Any later combination requires another fresh locked test.

final_promotion.status: Locked now; execute only after Screen C and a separately committed execution addendum bind the selected checkpoint and authoritative role result.
final_promotion.inspection_rule: Do not inspect efficacy until every shard, sidecar hash, and hardened reciprocal merge is complete.
promotion_gate: combined candidate match score - 1.645 * pair-clustered SE > 0.5
candidate match-score point estimate > 0.5 in each reciprocal orientation
zero caps, incomplete shards, gaps, overlaps, malformed rows, provenance mismatches, or operational errors
final_promotion.failed_panel_rule: A failed final panel burns its seeds and cannot be used to select another checkpoint.

retain: this plan and later execution-addendum SHA-256
compiler, flags, CPU, kernel, thread count, start/end UTC, wall and user time
rl, continuation_arena, and arena binary hashes
root, anchor, every generated checkpoint, and selected checkpoint hashes
all per-iteration diagnostics and raw paired rows
complete footers, sidecar hashes, canonical merges, and authoritative role-result artifact
provenance.native_checkpoint_warning: Checkpoint serialization is a native C struct and fast-math is enabled, so compiler and platform provenance are material.
